_README: Label id -> structure name for TotalSegmentator v2's 'abdominal_muscles' task, plus the reviewed mapping onto atlas entities.
A KEY, not data: it contains no anatomy and no geometry. Entries with atlas_id null are decisions NOT to map, each with its reason.
source: Wasserthal J et al., TotalSegmentator (Radiology: AI 2023, doi:10.1148/ryai.230024); class map transcribed from totalsegmentator/map_to_binary.py, v2.18.0, Apache-2.0. Task listed in the project README under 'Openly available for any usage (Apache-2.0 license)'.

trapezius_right.note: This task segments within T4-L4 only, so the mask is the thoracic part of the muscle; the cervical part is absent, not missing.

trapezius_left.note: This task segments within T4-L4 only, so the mask is the thoracic part of the muscle; the cervical part is absent, not missing.

erector_spinae_right.note: One mask over a group the atlas carries as separate entities; the ATLAS is finer than this task resolves, which no mapping can fix (same situation as 'autochthon' in the total task). Atlas: iliocostalis, longissimus, spinalis.

erector_spinae_left.note: One mask over a group the atlas carries as separate entities; the ATLAS is finer than this task resolves, which no mapping can fix (same situation as 'autochthon' in the total task). Atlas: iliocostalis, longissimus, spinalis.

transversospinalis_right.note: One mask over a group the atlas carries as separate entities; the ATLAS is finer than this task resolves, which no mapping can fix (same situation as 'autochthon' in the total task). Atlas: multifidus, rotatores, semispinalis.

transversospinalis_left.note: One mask over a group the atlas carries as separate entities; the ATLAS is finer than this task resolves, which no mapping can fix (same situation as 'autochthon' in the total task). Atlas: multifidus, rotatores, semispinalis.

psoas_major_right.note: Psoas major alone; the atlas carries iliopsoas as one entity and the total task already maps its iliopsoas mask onto it for the same subject. Not mapped a second time.

psoas_major_left.note: Psoas major alone; the atlas carries iliopsoas as one entity and the total task already maps its iliopsoas mask onto it for the same subject. Not mapped a second time.
